name: Arizona

windshield.strip: transparent material on the topmost portion, bottom edge at least 29 inches above the undepressed driver's seat (measured 5 in. in front of backrest, seat rearmost/lowest), not red or amber

frontSide.note: 33% plus or minus 3% light transmission, luminous reflectance 35% plus or minus 3%

backSide.note: no transmission limit; luminous reflectance 35% plus or minus 3% or less

rear.note: exempt if outside mirrors on both sides reflect at least 200 feet to the rear; reflectance limit 35% (+/-3%)

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ("light transmission" includes the glazing)

tolerance.cite: A.R.S. § 28-959.01(A)(1) ("thirty-three percent plus or minus three percent")

tint.dualMirrors: Rear window exemption requires outside mirrors on both left and right sides with a view of at least 200 feet to the rear (§ 28-959.01(A)(10))
tint.certificateOrSticker: No vehicle sticker; manufacturers must certify products to the director (D); sellers/installers must state conspicuously that front side window installation may be illegal in some states (F)

medicalExemption.text: ADOT (department/director) may issue an exemption on application by a person required for medical reasons to be shielded from the sun, supported by written attestation from a physician licensed under A.R.S. title 32, ch. 13, 14 or 17; covers the person's vehicle or one in which they are a habitual passenger; side and rear windows

penalty.text: Civil traffic violation (chapter 3); civil penalty not more than $250 plus surcharges

quotes: § 28-959.01(A)(1): "Front side wing vents and windows that have a substance or material in conjunction with glazing material that has a light transmission of thirty-three percent plus or minus three percent and a luminous reflectance of thirty-five percent plus or minus three percent."

(A)(6): "Side windows that are to the rear of the driver and rear windows that have a substance or material in conjunction with glazing material that has a luminous reflectance of thirty-five percent plus or minus three percent or less."
(A)(11)(a): "The bottom edge of the material is at least twenty-nine inches above the undepressed driver's seat..." (b) "The material is not red or amber in color."
(G): "...supported by written attestation of this fact from a physician licensed pursuant to title 32, chapter 13, 14 or 17, the department may issue an exemption..."
§ 28-1598: "...a civil penalty imposed pursuant to this article shall not exceed two hundred fifty dollars."

helmet.conditions: Operators and passengers under 18 must wear a helmet; citation only to 16-17 year-olds with a license/permit; eye protection required unless windshield

handheldPhone.fineText: Civil penalty $75 to $149 first violation; $400 second or subsequent; +$150 if a crash with a motorcycle

studdedTires.season: Oct 1 - May 1 (studs max 3% of tire contact area)

radarDetector.note: No Arizona ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

underglow.rule: No lamp capable of displaying red or red-and-blue light visible from directly in front; lights visible from the front must be amber or white; flashing lights prohibited except listed uses

liftHeight.rule: No height limit found; a pickup (GVWR 10,000 lb or less) modified from original bumper height to raise its center of gravity must have rear fender splash guards

openQuestions: Windshield strip defined by 29-inch seat measurement, not by AS-1 line or inches from top
